heading: Definition
lead: In this chapter, the term “essential vessel” means a vessel that is—

children.text: security for a mortgage indebtedness to the United States Government; or
constructed under this subtitle or required by a contract under this subtitle to be operated on a certain essential foreign trade route; and

tree.text: necessary in the interests of commerce and national defense to be maintained in condition for prompt use.
